555-the-unbearable-bassington.title: The Unbearable Bassington
555-the-unbearable-bassington.creator: Unknown
555-the-unbearable-bassington.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Francesca was one of those women towards whom Fate appears to have the best intentions and never to carry them into practice. With the advantages put at her disposal she might have been expected to command a more than average share of feminine happiness.

arxiv-1901-09998.title: Reduction of conceptual model uncertainty using ground-penetrating radar profiles: Field-demonstration for a braided-river aquifer
arxiv-1901-09998.creator: Guillaume Pirot, Emanuel Huber, James Irving, Niklas Linde
arxiv-1901-09998.description:
A 2019 arXiv research paper by Guillaume Pirot, Emanuel Huber, James Irving, Niklas Linde. Abstract

Hydrogeological flow and transport strongly depend on the connectivity of subsurface properties. Uncertainty concerning the underlying geological setting, due to a lack of field data and prior knowledge, calls for an evaluation of alternative geological conceptual models. To reduce the computational costs associated with inversions (parameter estimation for a given conceptual model), it is beneficial to rank and discard unlikely conceptual models prior to inversion.

arxiv-2103-07047.title: Inducibility of 4-vertex tournaments
arxiv-2103-07047.creator: Dalton Burke, Bernard Lidický, Florian Pfender, Michael Phillips
arxiv-2103-07047.description: Abstract We determine the inducibility of all tournaments with at most 4 4 vertices together with the extremal constructions. The 4 4 -vertex tournament containing an oriented C 3 C_{3} and one source vertex has a particularly interesting extremal construction, first conjectured by Bożyk, Grzesik and Kielak.

arxiv-2210-14084.title: Fast loaded dual species magneto-optical trap of cold Sodium and Potassium atoms with light-assisted inter-species interaction
arxiv-2210-14084.creator: Sagar Sutradhar, Anirban Misra, Gourab Pal, Sayari Majumder, Sanjukta Roy, Saptarishi Chaudhuri
arxiv-2210-14084.description: Abstract We present the design, implementation and detailed experimental characterization and comparison with numerical simulations of two-dimensional Magneto-optical traps (MOT) of bosonic 23 Na and 39 K atoms for loading the cold atomic mixture in a dual-species 3DMOT with a large number of atoms.

arxiv-2305-02934.title: Switched max-plus linear-dual inequalities: cycle time analysis and applications
arxiv-2305-02934.creator: Davide Zorzenon, Jan Komenda, Jörg Raisch
arxiv-2305-02934.description: Abstract P-time event graphs are discrete event systems suitable for modeling processes in which tasks must be executed in predefined time windows. Their dynamics can be represented by max-plus linear-dual inequalities (LDIs), i.e., systems of linear dynamical inequalities in the primal and dual operations of the max-plus algebra.

arxiv-2310-04996.title: Experiences with CAMRE: Single-Device Collaborative Adaptive Mixed Reality Environment
arxiv-2310-04996.creator: Hung-Jui Guo The University of Texas at Dallas, Omeed Eshaghi Ashtiani The University of Texas at Dallas, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran The University of Texas at Dallas
arxiv-2310-04996.description: Abstract During collaboration in XR (eXtended Reality), users typically share and interact with virtual objects in a common, shared virtual environment. Specifically, collaboration among users in Mixed Reality (MR) requires knowing their position, movement, and understanding of the visual scene surrounding their physical environments.

arxiv-2402-13147.title: SPRINQL: Sub-optimal Demonstrations driven Offline Imitation Learning
arxiv-2402-13147.creator: Huy Hoang, Tien Mai, Pradeep Varakantham
arxiv-2402-13147.description: Abstract We focus on offline imitation learning (IL), which aims to mimic an expert’s behavior using demonstrations without any interaction with the environment. One of the main challenges in offline IL is the limited support of expert demonstrations, which typically cover only a small fraction of the state-action space.

arxiv-2503-23229.title: Citegeist: Automated Generation of Related Work Analysis on the arXiv Corpus
arxiv-2503-23229.creator: Claas BegerCornell University cbb89@cornell.edu, Carl-Leander HennekingCornell University ch2273@cornell.edu
arxiv-2503-23229.description: Abstract Large Language Models provide significant new opportunities for the generation of high-quality written works. However, their employment in the research community is inhibited by their tendency to hallucinate invalid sources and lack of direct access to a knowledge base of relevant scientific articles.

britannica-1911-aspasius.title: Aspasius (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-aspasius.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-aspasius.description: Article 'Aspasius' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Another Aspasius, in the 3rd century A.D., was a Roman sophist and rhetorician, son or pupil of the rhetorician Demetrianus. He taught rhetoric in Rome, and filled the chair of rhetoric founded by Vespasian. He was secretary to the emperor Maximin. His orations, which are praised for their style, are lost.

britannica-1911-fantin-latour-ignace-hen.title: Fantin-Latour, Ignace Henri Jean Théodore (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fantin-latour-ignace-hen.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fantin-latour-ignace-hen.description: Article 'Fantin-Latour, Ignace Henri Jean Théodore' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. (1836–1904), French artist, was born at Grenoble on the 14th of January 1836. He studied first with his father, a pastel painter, and then at the drawing school of Lecoq de Boisbaudran, and later under Couture. He was the friend of Ingres, Dalacroix, Corot, Courbet and others.

britannica-1911-scolecite.title: Scolecite (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-scolecite.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-scolecite.description: Article 'Scolecite' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 24), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a hydrated calcium silicate, CaAl2Si3O10+3H2O. It is a lime-zeolite, and like the soda-zeolite natrolite and the soda-lime-zeolite mesolite, usually occurs as acicular and fibrous aggregations. Although having nearly the same interfacial angles as the orthorhombic natrolite, it crystallizes in the monoclinic system, and, as shown by the etched figures and the pyroelectric character, in the hemihedral class of this system, there being a plane, but no axis, of symmetry.

pmc-11513903.title: A role for cross-linking proteins in actin filament network organization and force generation
pmc-11513903.creator: Jennifer M. Hill, Songlin Cai, Michael D. Carver, David G. Drubin
pmc-11513903.description: SignificanceCells internalize nutrients and membrane-bound molecules through a highly coordinated process called clathrin-mediated endocytosis (CME). In budding yeast, high turgor pressure necessitates generation of substantial forces by an actin filament network and associated proteins to bend the membrane and internalize a vesicle.

pmc-11516625.title: 7.P. Skills building seminar: Using health impact assessment for assessing tobacco control policies
pmc-11516625.creator: Organised by: European Burden of Disease Network, EUPHA-HIA, Chair persons: Brecht Devleesschauwer (Belgium), Piedad Martin-Olmedo (EUPHA-HIA)
pmc-11516625.description: Tobacco use is the largest contributor to premature death and preventable disease in Europe. Despite decreasing tobacco use in recent years, the European Commission estimates that the number of smokers in Europe is 26% in the population, and 29% among 15-24 year olds. This persistent public health risk is amenable to policy, but targeted and effective strategies are needed.

pmc-12425296.title: Estimating the population size of gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men in four major provinces in Canada: A descriptive study using data from a population-based survey
pmc-12425296.creator: Felipe Tavares Duailibe, David Moore, Mark Hull, Viviane D. Lima
pmc-12425296.description: BackgroundEstimating the size of key populations is critical for effective research and policy development. We estimated the population size of gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBM) based on different definitions and compared the demographic composition of the GBM and non-GBM populations in Canada.

pmc-12567312.title: Mechanism of Exogenous Dopamine Regulating Shine Muscat Grape in Response to Low-Temperature Stress
pmc-12567312.creator: Jiaxin Li, Qiujie Wu, Jiahui Cheng, Jingxuan Zhu, Peisen Su, Jiayuan Wu, Xiucai Fan, Guirong Li
pmc-12567312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To reveal the mechanism by which exogenous dopamine (Da) regulates Shine Muscat grape (Vitis labrusca L. × Vitis vinifera L.) in response to low-temperature stress, annual Shine Muscat grape plants were used as material. Different concentrations of Da (0.2–1.0 mmol L−1) were set to investigate its synergistic regulatory effects on grape photosynthetic protection, osmotic adjustment, ion homeostasis, antioxidant defense, and cold-responsive gene expression and to identify the optimal concentration and core pathways through correlation analysis.

pmc-12593904.title: Intra-articular injections for shoulder arthritis in adults: a systematic review
pmc-12593904.creator: Filippo Migliorini, Luise Schäfer, Virginia Masoni, Fabrizio Rivera, Gennaro Pipino, Nicola Maffulli
pmc-12593904.description: BackgroundThe management of glenohumeral osteoarthritis (GHOA) is challenging, particularly in patients who are not eligible for surgery. In recent years, several injectable therapies, including hyaluronic acid (HA), corticosteroids (CCs), platelet-rich plasma (PRP), bone marrow aspirate concentrate (BMAC), and mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), have emerged as potential options for managing pain and improving joint function.

pmc-13035120.title: Implementing allied healthcare professionals in transitional care for older adults with mental health needs: A scoping review
pmc-13035120.creator: Marina Motsenok, Ella C.N. Wong, Rozhannaa Sothilingam, Monica Antunes, Catherine Devion, Emma Wilson, Amanda Knoepfli, Emma Elliot, Tracey DasGupta, Naomi Ziegler, Sander L. Hitzig, Dragan Hrncic, Dragan Hrncic, Dragan Hrncic
pmc-13035120.description: IntroductionOlder adults experience several transitions in care, which can be challenging and stressful. Transitional care ensures continuity of care by addressing patients’ healthcare needs before discharge and providing ongoing community support. Although transitional care improves patient outcomes and reduces hospital readmissions, its role in addressing mental health (MH) needs in older adults remains underexplored.

pmc-13394137.title: Pathophysiological and Molecular Features of DXd ADC‐Related Interstitial Pneumonitis in Cynomolgus Monkeys
pmc-13394137.creator: Kazuyoshi Kumagai, Takuma Iguchi, Kentaro Kubota, Ken Sakurai, Yoshimi Tsuchiya, Katsuyoshi Chiba
pmc-13394137.description: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is an important adverse event related to deruxtecan‐based antibody‐drug conjugates (DXd ADCs). Understanding mechanisms and translationally relevant preclinical models remain incompletely defined. Here, we established a reproducible cynomolgus monkey model of DXd ADC‐related ILD and performed the first integration of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) extracellular vesicle (EV) proteomics with lung single‐cell RNA sequencing (scRNA‐seq).

pmc-13422946.creator: Leonie Arns-Glaser, Elea Widrig, Vasileios Nittas, Jan S Fehr, Benjamin Hampel, Andrea Farnham

pmc-13586824.title: The mechanism of vascular injury caused by polystyrene microplastics: Involving ferroptosis and metabolomics
pmc-13586824.creator: Deyu Zhu, Xiao Liang, Qi Huang, Yang Wu, Zhuangzhuang Wei, Shenyang Cai, Qing Feng, Ping Ma, Xu Yang, Cuiyu Bao, Xinyu Bao
pmc-13586824.description: SummaryPolystyrene microplastics (PS-MPs) are environmental pollutants linked to cardiovascular diseases. This study investigated PS-MP-induced vascular toxicity mechanisms in mice. Mice were divided into saline control, low/medium/high PS-MP exposure (0.1, 1, and 10 mg/kg/d), and PS-MPs plus ferroptosis inhibitor Ferrostatin-1 (1 mg/kg/d + Fer-1) for 5 weeks.

pmc-13595154.title: Conjunctival myxoid stromal tumor: Case series of a rare neoplasm
pmc-13595154.creator: Emma C Stenz, Lucy Evans, Mukul K Divatia, Kathryn P Scherpelz
pmc-13595154.description: PurposeTo report three cases of conjunctival stromal tumor (COST) with myxoid features and describe their microscopic characteristics and provide a review of the pertinent literature.ObservationThis case series consists of three patients who were found to have conjunctival growths consistent with conjunctival stomal tumors with myxoid features.
